original_test_intent: Verify that the selected GB-NV-PVP PCIe path completes five hundred full-width Gen3-to-Gen5 transitions with valid high-generation training and no new link, GPU, or system errors.
original_method: Validate end-to-end Gen5 capability and pin Speed Change 35; for each numbered cycle establish and record full-width Gen3, request Gen5, observe intermediate LTSSM/equalization, capture settled Gen5 width plus error/health deltas, and prohibit the next transition after any missing or failed result; use owner-approved console recovery.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves the Gen5-capable path and Speed Change 35 recipe; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own recovery from endpoint, GPU, or host loss.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 35 configuration
Complete Gen5-capable PCIe hierarchy and required lane width
Method proving full-width Gen3 at each cycle start
Gen5 request/equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle timeout, transient, width, and error rules
500-count, artifact-integrity, abort, final-state, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated approved SUT with stable power/cooling and console
Validate target path, Gen3 start, and Gen5 support
Stop on wrong start, unsupported target, equalization/retrain failure, late/reduced-width Gen5, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or artifact gap
No continuation or automatic retry after anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify tool, topology, capability, start method, and acceptance
Run only the pinned approved transaction
Persist initial/intermediate/final states and error/health evidence atomically
Fail closed before the next cycle
Do not infer capability, substitute another speed-change case, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Speed Change 35 and complete Gen5 path
Set Gen3-entry and Gen5 equalization/width/timing/error criteria
Review all 500 records and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Preserves the specific Gen3-to-Gen5 repetition and adds the path, initial-state, transaction, failure, and recovery controls needed to make it auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Gen3 starting state is part of this case's distinct coverage. Without recording it per cycle, a tool could remain at Gen5 and produce nominal results without exercising the requested transition. Gen5 equalization and width also depend on the full physical path; later stable LnkSta cannot expose earlier Recovery loops or corrected errors. Each cycle must therefore commit its Gen3 entry, training trajectory, Gen5/full-width settle, and error delta before the next request is allowed.
